rows.ja: 提携・検証・共同開発
サーバー・部品メーカー(提携)
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: TSMCがAstera Labsの唯一のファウンドリーで、全ICを製造
relations.text_en: TSMC is Astera Labs’ sole foundry partner, manufacturing all of its integrated circuits

source.label: Astera Labs 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We currently partner with TSMC to manufacture our integrated circuits. TSMC is our sole manufacturing partner for our integrated circuits and we currently have not qualified another source.

relations.text: ASEがAstera LabsのICの組立・パッケージ・テストを担当
relations.text_en: ASE assembles, packages and tests Astera Labs’ ICs

source.label: Astera Labs 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We use Advanced Semiconductor Engineering and Amkor Technologies to assemble, package, and test our ICs.

relations.text: AmkorがAstera LabsのICの組立・パッケージ・テストを担当
relations.text_en: Amkor assembles, packages and tests Astera Labs’ ICs

source.label: Astera Labs 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We use Advanced Semiconductor Engineering and Amkor Technologies to assemble, package, and test our ICs.

relations.text: Amazon.comはAstera Labsの顧客で、2022年10月発行(2023年10月修正)のワラントを保有
relations.text_en: Amazon.com is a customer of Astera Labs and holds a warrant issued in October 2022 as amended in October 2023

source.label: Astera Labs 8-K(2026年2月5日)
source.quote: The Parent is a customer of the Company and holds a warrant issued in October 2022, as amended in October 2023.

relations.text: Amazonに新たなワラント(最大3,262,299株)を付与。Amazonによる最大65億ドルの購入に応じて権利が確定
relations.text_en: Granted Amazon a new warrant (up to 3,262,299 shares) that vests on Amazon purchases of up to $6.5B of Astera products

source.label: Astera Labs 8-K(2026年2月5日)
source.quote: Warrant Shares vest upon the achievement of performance conditions, comprised of specified tranches of payments (as specified in the Warrant) by or on behalf of the Parent and its affiliates, for the purchase up to a total of $6.5 billion, of our smart fabric switch products, signal conditioning products and optical engine products.
source.note: 権利の確定は今後の購入次第です。
source.note_en: Vesting is conditional on future purchases.

relations.text: Astera LabsのLeo CXLスマート・メモリー・コントローラーがMicrosoft AzureのM系列VM(プレビュー)で使われている
relations.text_en: Astera Leo CXL Smart Memory Controllers are used in Microsoft Azure M-Series VMs (preview)

source.label: Astera Labs ブログ
source.quote: Our Leo CXL Smart Memory Controllers smashed the memory wall on Microsoft Azure M-Series VMs.
source.note: プレビュー段階の導入です。日付はブログの公開日で、出来事は2025年です。
source.note_en: A preview-stage deployment; the date is the blog’s publication date (the event was in 2025).

relations.text: NVLink Fusionのエコシステム向けにスケールアップ接続を提供するためNVIDIAと協業
relations.text_en: Collaborating with NVIDIA to provide scale-up connectivity for the NVLink Fusion ecosystem

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: today announced it is collaborating with NVIDIA to provide scale-up connectivity solutions for the new NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem.

relations.text: AMDがAstera Aries Smart Retimerを量産環境で検証済みで、PCIe 7への移行で協業
relations.text_en: AMD has validated Astera Aries Smart Retimers in production and is collaborating on the PCIe 7 transition

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: AMD and Intel have each validated Aries Smart Retimers in production across their platforms from PCIe 4 through 6.

relations.text: AMDが、オープンなラック設計でのAMD Instinct GPU向けUALink接続でAstera Labsと協業していると説明
relations.text_en: AMD cites its collaboration with Astera Labs on UALink connectivity for AMD Instinct GPUs in open rack architectures

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: Our collaboration with Astera Labs on UALink connectivity ensures our joint customers can deploy AMD Instinct GPUs at scale in open rack architectures that deliver performance, energy efficiency and flexibility. Danny Moore, Director, AI Technology and Ecosystems at AMD

relations.text: IntelがAstera Aries Smart Retimerを量産環境で検証済みで、PCIe 7への移行で協業
relations.text_en: Intel has validated Astera Aries Smart Retimers in production and is collaborating on the PCIe 7 transition

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: AMD and Intel have each validated Aries Smart Retimers in production across their platforms from PCIe 4 through 6.

relations.text: Arm Total Designに参加し、ArmのNeoverse CSSと組み合わせたAIチップレット向けのカスタム設計を提供
relations.text_en: Joined Arm Total Design to combine its platform with Arm Neoverse CSS for custom AI chiplet solutions

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: This collaboration will combine Astera Labs’ Intelligent Connectivity Platform ecosystem with Arm Neoverse CSS to enable chiplet solutions that meet the growing demand for custom AI infrastructure.

relations.text: ArmとAstera Labsが、Arm AGI CPUとLeo CXLスマート・メモリー・コントローラーを組み合わせる
relations.text_en: Arm and Astera Labs are pairing the Arm AGI CPU with Leo CXL Smart Memory Controllers

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: Arm and Astera Labs are working together to pair Arm AGI CPU with Leo CXL Smart Memory Controllers

relations.text: MicronのSSDとScorpio P-Seriesスイッチで、PCIe 6のストレージ性能が毎秒100GB超を持続することを共同で実証
relations.text_en: Demonstrated over 100 GB/s sustained PCIe 6 storage throughput with Micron SSDs and Scorpio P-Series switches

source.label: Astera Labs ブログ
source.quote: Astera Labs and Micron achieved a groundbreaking milestone: over 100 GB/s of sustained throughput using production-ready PCIe 6 technology.

relations.text: SamsungがLeoファミリーを軸にCXLメモリー製品でAstera Labsと協業
relations.text_en: Samsung Electronics is collaborating with Astera Labs on CXL memory solutions around the Leo family

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: Jangseok Choi, Vice President of Product Planning Team at Samsung Electronics, said: “We are contributing to the evolution of AI infrastructure through the development of CXL memory solutions

relations.text: AIラック規模のシリコン・エコシステムでAlchipと戦略的提携を発表
relations.text_en: Announced a strategic partnership with Alchip on the AI rack-scale silicon ecosystem

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: Alchip Technologies, the high-performance ASIC leader, today announced a strategic partnership to advance the silicon ecosystem for next generation AI infrastructure.

relations.text: Lumentumが自社のフォトニック・エンジンとAsteraのAries 7光ドライバー・TIAを組み合わせる
relations.text_en: Lumentum pairs its photonic engines with Astera’s Aries 7 Smart Optical Driver and TIA

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: Matt Sysak, Chief Technology Officer, Lumentum: “Linear optics works at scale only if the electrical and optical halves of the link are designed together from the start.

relations.text: Amphenol High Speed Cablesが、ラック規模のケーブル製品でAstera Labsと提携
relations.text_en: Amphenol High Speed Cables is partnering with Astera Labs on rack-scale cable solutions

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: Our relationship with Astera Labs will ensure customers have access to reliable, high-speed cable solutions that extend Astera Labs’ connectivity capabilities from board-level to rack-scale deployments with supply chain diversity. Mark St. Hilaire, General Manager of Amphenol High Speed Cables
source.note: 事業部門レベルの発言です。

relations.text: PCIe 6ラック規模の接続向けのアナログ・シミュレーションと検証でAstera Labsと協業
relations.text_en: Cadence collaborates with Astera Labs on analog simulation and verification for PCIe 6 rack-scale links

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: Our collaboration with Astera Labs gives engineers the analog simulation and verification tools to get these high-speed connections right the first time, because at rack scale, there’s no room for signal integrity surprises. Ashutosh Mauskar, Vice President, Product Management, Custom Systems Design and Analysis Products at Cadence Design Systems

relations.text: オープンなラック設計の普及に向けAstera Labsと協業
relations.text_en: Synopsys collaborates with Astera Labs to accelerate adoption of open rack architectures

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: Our collaboration with Astera Labs brings essential technologies to the ecosystem, accelerating the adoption of open rack architectures and enabling customers to achieve performance, interoperability, and scalability at rack scale. Neeraj Paliwal, Senior Vice President of IP Product Management at Synopsys

relations.text: AsteraのAriesリタイマーをアクティブ・バックプレーン設計に組み込む
relations.text_en: TE Connectivity embeds Astera Aries retimers into active backplane designs

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: By incorporating Astera Labs’ intelligent retimers into our active backplane designs, we’re delivering increased density and reliable rack-scale connectivity while maintaining the high-speed performance for demanding AI workloads. Pranav Garg, Vice President, Strategy, Business Development and Marketing, Digital Data Networks Business Unit at TE Connectivity
source.note: 事業部門レベルの発言です。

relations.text: AsteraのPCIe 6の立ち上げを高度なテストソリューションで支援
relations.text_en: Keysight supports Astera Labs’ PCIe 6 ramp with advanced testing solutions

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: Keysight is proud to support its momentum with advanced testing solutions that ensure the highest standards for performance and compliance.

relations.text: Asteraの接続技術を自社の光トランシーバーに組み込む
relations.text_en: Eoptolink will integrate Astera connectivity intelligence with its optical transceivers

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: Working with Astera Labs, we’ll integrate their connectivity intelligence with our advanced optical transceivers to deliver power-efficient, high-bandwidth solutions that maintain signal integrity across the extended distances required for modern AI data center architectures. Sean Davies, Vice President of Sales at Eoptolink
source.note: 「組み込む予定」という段階です。

relations.text: ラック規模のAIシステムの検証・統合で協業する台湾のODMの1社としてWiwynnを挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Wiwynn among Taiwan ODMs it collaborates with on rack-scale AI system validation and integration

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: In collaboration with AI platform providers AMD, Arm, Intel, and NVIDIA and Taiwan original design manufacturers (ODMs) including GIGABYTE, Ingrasys (a subsidiary of Foxconn), Inventec, Quanta Cloud Technology, and Wiwynn, Astera Labs will strengthen the validation and system integration work required to bring purpose-built AI infrastructure to market faster.

relations.text: ハイパースケール向け製品の製造でAstera Labsと協業
relations.text_en: Wistron manufactures products for hyperscale deployments in collaboration with Astera Labs

source.label: Astera Labs の発表
source.quote: Working with Astera Labs, Wistron is committed to delivering excellent and reliable manufactured products for hyperscale deployments.

relations.text: Astera Labsが年次報告で、主な競合の1社としてBroadcomを挙げている
relations.text_en: Astera Labs’ FY2025 10-K names Broadcom as a principal competitor

source.label: Astera Labs 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors include Broadcom, Inc., Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd., Marvell Technology, Inc., Microchip Technology Inc., Montage Technology, Parade Technologies, Ltd., and Rambus, Inc.
source.note: 一部の製品・ソリューションで競合する、という記載です。
